summary: The construction and proof are correct. The row formulas, deficit sum, support size, ambient dimension, and parity census agree for both parities of L, including the smallest admissible value L=32 and centers with zero deficit. The auxiliary cross-polytope bound exhausts all possible integer auxiliary vectors, and its signed coordinate sections contain exactly the prescribed spikes, proving lattice completeness. Reflection at each all-even center receives precisely its base-row contribution and its own attached pairs, giving h_W(x)=m. The class-energy normalization and its conditional identification with the sum of Psi_x are exact; the stated uniform-support scaling distinction is also correct. No external or predecessor facts are required, and no mathematical errors or gaps were found.
